title: R1 tenant branch identity access and control-plane closure
businessRules: Company identity remains derived from trusted authenticated context; client companyId never selects another tenant.
New company provisioning remains bootstrap/deployment controlled because the current product has no cross-company membership model; operators may manage only the active company profile.
User home branch remains persisted on User.branchId; active branch switching is per AuthSession.activeBranchId and never mutates home-branch ownership.
Branch switching is allowed only to active branches in the same company and requires branch.switch; denied attempts are audited.
Refresh rotation and JwtAuthGuard preserve and revalidate session active-branch context against the home company.
Role/permission/user-status and control-plane mutations remain backend-authorized and audited; UI visibility is not an authorization boundary.
R1 CRITICAL/HIGH findings require live PostgreSQL GitHub evidence before CLOSED.
acceptanceCriteria: F07 current company profile is operable from Admin while company creation remains explicitly BOOTSTRAP_ONLY.
F08 Admin exposes same-company branch switching backed by AuthSession.activeBranchId with cross-branch/cross-company denial.
F09 Admin exposes user creation, user status, user-role assignment, role creation, and role-permission management.
F10 Admin exposes system settings, custom fields, webhooks, approval policies/queue, UI schema, audit log, outbox, and ops health.
SQLite/PostgreSQL expand migration parity adds AuthSession.activeBranchId without destructive reset.
GitHub full-system and manual Full UAT require the R1 tenant/access runtime probe.
Local workflow/repo/full audit/UI audit/recovery audit and dependency-free regression pass.
testPlan: npm run uat:pre-github:local on dependency-complete Windows repo
GitHub Full System Simulation / Toko360 Full Automated UAT: npm run ci:r1:probe against live PostgreSQL exact runtime
migrationPlan: Apply expand-only T360-20260924-r1-session-branch-context after the existing F11 transaction-UOM migration in SQLite rehearsal and PostgreSQL production-order manifest. No destructive column/table changes.
rollbackPlan: Application rollback may ignore activeBranchId and fall back to User.branchId. Do not drop the expand-only column during rollback; remove it only in a later reviewed contract migration if ever required.
monitoringPlan: GitHub R1 evidence records source fingerprint, company/home/active branch identities, same-company switch, denial probes, access lifecycle, and control-plane health. Audit logs record tenant profile and branch-context mutations.
securityNotes: No API accepts arbitrary tenant identity as authority. Company creation is not exposed. Branch target is revalidated server-side in the authenticated company. Sensitive control-plane routes have explicit Permissions decorators. Secrets remain redacted/encrypted.
